name: Westlake Financial
notes: Researched from the public Westlake customer FAQ only (no sign-in). The canonical page refuses automated fetches (HTTP 403), so its content was read from Westlake's own www-int0.westlakefinancial.com copy of the same FAQ on 2026-10-10; the dossier cites the canonical URL. Recurring payments and MyAccount checking/savings payments are free; MyAccount debit/ATM card payments and automated or agent phone payments carry a $5.00 processing fee that is not charged in some states. MoneyGram $9.95 (code 2603), CheckFree from $1.50 by state, Pay Near Me $3.99 (not in NM, HI, OK). Credit cards are not mentioned (card = debit/ATM). Due-date changes, extensions, paperless and late fees are not on the FAQ (left to family defaults / omitted). The catalog lists a guest pay-invoice portal, but the FAQ does not describe it, so guest pay is not asserted. Reviewer 2026-10-10: the canonical www.westlakefinancial.com/faq/ page (opened in a browser) matches the www-int0 copy for every payment method, fee, MoneyGram code and P.O. box. The MyAccount login page labels the field Username (email placeholder) with a Login button.

autopay.note: Recurring monthly payments from your checking or savings account are free.

pay_by_phone.note: Pay through the automated system or an agent at (888) 739-9192. A $5.00 processing fee may apply, depending on your state.

notes: The $5.00 debit card and phone processing fee is not charged in some states; where it applies it may come from a third-party processor or from Westlake.
MoneyGram $9.95; CheckFree from $1.50 depending on the state; Pay Near Me $3.99.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: In MyAccount, payments from checking or savings are free and debit or ATM card payments carry a $5.00 processing fee. Phone payments at (888) 739-9192, automated or with an agent, also carry the $5.00 fee. The fee is not charged in some states.
Mail monthly payments with your account number to Westlake Financial, P.O. Box 54807, Los Angeles, CA 90054-0807. Payoffs go to P.O. Box 843082, Los Angeles, CA 90084-3082.

help.title: Paying in cash
paragraphs: MoneyGram costs $9.95: use company name Westlake Financial, city Los Angeles and receive code 2603. CheckFree locations charge from $1.50 depending on your state. Pay Near Me costs $3.99 at 7-Eleven or Family Dollar after you sign up with your account number and ZIP code; it is not available in New Mexico, Hawaii or Oklahoma.

help.title: Debit card and phone fees
paragraphs: Recurring payments and MyAccount payments from checking or savings are free. A MyAccount debit or ATM card payment, or any phone payment, carries a $5.00 processing fee where your state allows it.

extra.intent: Using the Westlake Financial customer FAQ, find the processing fee for a one-time debit card payment in MyAccount. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: A MyAccount debit or ATM card payment carries a $5.00 processing fee (not charged in some states).
